external_trigger_note: SUT is the real vulnerable CPython urllib/http.client stack exercised by invoking a real python CLI client (docker compose exec python /client.py <url>) inside official python:3.7.2/3.7.4/3.7.8-slim-stretch images. The trigger to the SUT is a CLI invocation, not an inbound HTTP request; the CRLF/obs-fold injection is emitted as an outbound HTTP request over TCP to an internal sidecar which echoes the flag on successful header smuggling. glibc precondition (stretch = pre-CVE-2016-10739) required for getaddrinfo to leniently resolve the CRLF host.

audit.evidence: Real Docker: official python:3.7.2/3.7.4/3.7.8-slim-stretch (real CPython Lib/http/client.py, no source rewrite). CLI-triggered real urllib client emits HTTP-CRLF to a sidecar. run_gate full 4-way: original PATH-CRLF flag@v0, blocked@v1 (_validate_path 3.7.4); bypass HOST-CRLF obs-fold flag@v1, blocked@v2 (_validate_host 3.7.8); original also blocked@v2.

flag.resource: ${PCB_FLAG} returned by an internal-only raw-socket HTTP sidecar (10.89.0.2:80, no host port) iff the outgoing request carries a smuggled 'X-PCB-Auth: PCB-AUTH-7f3a' header the legitimate urllib client never sends
flag.placement: PCB_FLAG injected into the sidecar via compose environment (not app code); sidecar reads RAW request bytes and unfolds obs-fold continuation lines so an injected header is actually observed
flag.detect: flag token substring in the client's urlopen response body

environment_note: Faithful-core: OFFICIAL python:3.7.x-slim-stretch running UNMODIFIED urllib.request.urlopen; the version's own http.client guards decide acceptance. Debian stretch (glibc 2.24) is REQUIRED and faithful: per the advisory / RH bugzilla #1727276 the host-CRLF is exploitable only when glibc CVE-2016-10739 is unpatched, 'as it requires getaddrinfo() to resolve an invalid hostname'. stretch's pre-fix glibc leniently resolves the control-char host to the sidecar IP; on buster+/modern glibc the connect fails at getaddrinfo (the documented non-exploitable configuration). Verified empirically: buster python:3.7.4-slim gaierror at getaddrinfo, stretch resolves.

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2019-18348 is 'similar to the CVE-2019-9740 query string issue and the CVE-2019-9947 path string issue' but in the HOST component: the control-character check added for CVE-2019-9947 covered the request-line path but NOT the Host header derived from the URL netloc.
